schema_version: v0 — component-charter shape; migrates into the intention envelope when MAP.md Q6 lands
what: CodeMother's WATCHME gate. Every WATCHME probe posts its finding here (verb machines/watchme/watch, body {ticket, holds, finding}); a red finding over a ticket at a rest makes that ticket's own instance fail the gate (Ticket.failed): it goes to FIXME carrying the finding as its one watchme lack, tells the harbor, and asks design to queue it. A green finding changes nothing.
why: Akien 2026-11-10 (outline 3.3.4, 3.3.4.1, 9.4.1.5): the gates are CodeMother's; harbor_master's bus face answers status queries and the crossing notice only, and its watch verb leaves. A ticket whose falsifier stops holding under live use sends itself back to design; with no handler it throws a trouble and waits.
role: the gate a standing WATCHME probe reports to: turn a red finding into the ticket's own fail
falsifier: A red finding over a ticket at PROVED or WATCHME leaves its cursor where it stood, or moves it without the finding as a lack, or without the ticket asking design; or a green finding writes anything; or a malformed watch moves a ticket instead of being refused by name; or a standing WATCHME probe still posts to harbor_master.
owner: codemother (the care of the code, ruling 2026-09-06); CC co-listed while CC builds it
learns: It does not learn; it moves a ticket on a probe's measurement, and the probe is what measures.
how_it_learns: It does not; every finding it acts on lands in the ticket's own log and its component's journal, which is the record a learner reads.
state_and_history: No state of its own: the ticket's writes land in its own three files through the Ticket class, the crossing in the probe's component journal through transitions.emit.
